dedupe_keys.name: network data of the district heating system of sønderborg 2016 2019

description: This data set gives measured heat load and feed and return flow temperatures from seven heating plants of the district heating systems of Sønderborg, Denmark. It was published under the name of the operator Sønderborg Varme A/S. The data were preprocessed before release: files were converted from XLSX to CSV, Danish labels translated to English, data split by year, missing dates at the end of November and in December added, and missing-data flags replaced by empty cells, while the raw data are kept in a ZIP archive. Coverage is the seven plants for 2016 to 2019 at 15-minute resolution. Files are four yearly CSV files and a raw ZIP, about 93 MB in total, on Zenodo (version 1.0.0, published May 2023) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: gaps were filled with empty rows, not values, and the data describe plants, not the full network topology. Simulation uses are dispatch optimisation, storage sizing and forecasting for district heating. Related records: data-flensburg-district-heating-network is a similar data set from Germany.
name: Network data of the district heating system of Sønderborg (2016-2019)
